mapper.sql: id , factory_id, workshop_id, production_line_id, project_id, monomer_id, area_id, product_id, product_type, product_process_id, scheduling_quantity, task_quantity, complete_quantity, ask_complete_time, complete_time, STATUS, issue_status, user_id, create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version
mapper.select:
select a.id, a.project_id 'project.id', a.monomer_id 'monomer.id', a.area_id 'area.id', a.factory_id 'factory.id', a.workshop_id 'workshop.id', a.production_line_id 'production_line.id', cp.`name` 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number', pm.`name` 'monomer.name', pd.`name` 'area.name', mbf.`name` 'factory.name', mbw.`name` 'workshop.name', mbpl.`name` 'production_line.name', a.product_id, a.product_type, a.product_process_id, a.scheduling_quantity, a.task_quantity, a.complete_quantity, a.ask_complete_time, a.complete_time, a.STATUS, a.issue_status, product.serial_number serial_number,
product.plate plate, product.`name`, product.color,
product.specification specification, product.`name`, material,
product.specification specification, material,
product.specification specification,
product.length length, a.user_id, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.bool_delete_enum, a.version, (SELECT SUM(in_production_quantity) FROM mes_building_task WHERE scheduling_id=a.id AND bool_delete_enum=FALSE AND product_type=a.product_type) in_production_quantity from mes_building_scheduling a LEFT JOIN mes_building_factory mbf ON a.factory_id = mbf.id AND mbf.bool_delete_enum=FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop mbw ON a.workshop_id = mbw.id AND mbw.bool_delete_enum=FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line mbpl ON a.production_line_id=mbpl.id AND mbpl.bool_delete_enum=FALSE LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id =a.project_id AND cp.bool_delete_enum=FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.id =a.monomer_id AND pm.bool_delete_enum=FALSE LEFT JOIN plan_area pd ON pd.id =a.area_id AND pd.bool_delete_enum=FALSE
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble product ON a.product_id =product.id
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact product ON a.product_id =product.id
LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure product ON a.product_id =product.id
LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part product ON a.product_id =product.id
a.id = #{id}

SELECT
IFNULL((SELECT sum(task_quantity) FROM mes_building_task WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND product_type = #{productType} )/b.quantity,0)
IFNULL((SELECT sum(scheduling_quantity) FROM mes_building_scheduling WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND product_type = #{productType} ),0)
total_scheduling_quantity, IFNULL((SELECT sum(task_quantity) FROM mes_building_task WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND product_type = #{productType} ),0) total_task_quantity, IFNULL((SELECT sum(in_production_quantity) FROM mes_building_task WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND product_type = #{productType} ),0) in_production_quantity, IFNULL((SELECT sum(complete_quantity) FROM mes_building_task WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND product_type = #{productType} ),0) complete_quantity FROM
tech_assemble a
tech_artifact a
tech_enclosure a
tech_machine_part a
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble_machine_part_link b ON a.id=b.machine_part_id AND b.assemble_id=#{assembleId}
WHERE a.id=#{productId}

SELECT * FROM mes_building_scheduling WHERE DATE ( create_time )= date (#{today}) AND DATE ( ask_complete_time )= date (#{askTime}) AND product_id=#{productId} AND product_type=#{productType} AND production_line_id=#{productionLineId} AND task_quantity<>0 AND bool_delete_enum=0 LIMIT 1
SELECT IFNULL( sum( quantity ), 0 ) FROM mes_building_artifact_scheduling WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND product_id = #{productId}
